Class HistoCurve

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.splot.pdata.ACurve
edu.cnu.mdi.splot.pdata.HistoCurve
public class HistoCurve extends ACurve
Histogram-backed curve that integrates HistoData into the ACurve fitting and drawing framework.

Thread-safety

The ACurve contract requires that notifications (e.g. ACurve.markDataChanged()) occur on the Swing Event Dispatch Thread (EDT). This class preserves that contract while allowing histogram filling from any thread:

  • If add(double) or addAll(double[]) are called on the EDT, they apply immediately and notify once.
  • If called off the EDT, values are enqueued and a coalesced EDT drain is scheduled. The drain applies many samples in bulk and notifies once.
  • clearData() follows the same pattern: on the EDT it clears immediately, off the EDT it discards any pending samples and defers the clear to the EDT.

    • add

      public void add(double x)
      Add a value to the histogram.

      Safe from any thread. Off-EDT calls enqueue and schedule a coalesced EDT drain. The ACurve notification contract is preserved: ACurve.markDataChanged() is invoked on the EDT only.

      Parameters:
      x - the value to add

    • addAll

      public void addAll(double[] x)
      Add multiple values to the histogram.

      Safe from any thread. Off-EDT calls enqueue and schedule a coalesced EDT drain. The ACurve notification contract is preserved: ACurve.markDataChanged() is invoked on the EDT only.

      Parameters:
      x - the values to add (non-null)

    • drainPendingOnEDT

      public int drainPendingOnEDT(int max)
      Drain pending enqueued values on the EDT and apply them to the histogram.

      This method is EDT-only because it ultimately fires ACurve.markDataChanged().

      Parameters:
      max - maximum number of values to apply in this drain pass
      Returns:
      number of drained values

    • clearData

      public void clearData()
      Clear histogram contents and statistics.

      Safe from any thread, honoring the ACurve.clearData() contract. If called off the EDT, any not-yet-applied pending samples are discarded and the clear is deferred to (and coalesced with other scheduled drains on) the EDT. The ACurve notification contract is preserved: ACurve.markDataChanged() is invoked on the EDT only.

      Specified by:
      clearData in class ACurve
